{{Quote|Chewbacca has wisely decided that we must adopt the stance of our enemy to defeat them. Therefore, Chewbacca has decided that the Trade Federation will have no place on Alaris Prime.|Qui-Gon Jinn, in a transmission to the Jedi High Council|audio=ChewbaccaHatesFeds.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
The '''Battle for Alaris Prime''' was fought between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]]. The battle occurred between the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonists]] and the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] and was the deciding battle of the [[Alaris Prime colonial war|conflict]] between the two sides over the rights to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]]. The Wookiee leader [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] had been attacking Trade Federation settlements and targeted the Trade Federation's main [[Unidentified Trade Federation base|base]] in a final push to remove the enemy presence, aiming to destroy the Federation's [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]] per the advice of his [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]], [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]]. At a [[Unidentified Wookiee base (fortress)|base]] established near the Federation one, Chewbacca and the Wookiees, including his cousin [[Shoran]] and [[Parent/Legends|father]] [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]], upgraded their defenses and technology while the Trade Federation [[Commanding officer/Legends|commander]] [[SRAM-13]] initiated the battle by sending attacks on Wookiee [[Sentry tower/Legends|sentry posts]].

Once the Wookiees built their own fortress, Jinn arrived at the base to participate in the battle. SRAM-13 sent [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|light droid starfighters]] to [[Scout/Legends|scout]] the Wookiee base, prompting the latter to strengthen their [[Atmosphere/Legends|air]] defenses. The Wookiees eventually built up their forces, including [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and [[Energy pummel/Legends|energy pummels]], and broke into the Trade Federation base and destroyed its fortress. The company's [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] ally [[Pekt]] escaped from the ruined fortress, and the Wookiees were finally able to continue their [[Colonist/Legends|colonization]] of Alaris Prime, turning the moon into a successful technological hub for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|The Trade Federation will be testing your defenses on a regular basis. It is best to stay prepared.|Qui-Gon Jinn, to the Wookiees|audio=FederationTesting.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
Between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]],<ref name="NEC39" /> the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] was engulfed in a [[Alaris Prime colonial war|war]] between the competing [[Colonist/Legends|colonies]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] and the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonists]]. The Wookiee [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] had taken leadership of the colonists following a near-[[Death/Legends|fatal]] [[Ambush of Attichitcuk|ambush]] by the Trade Federation against the previous leader, his [[Parent/Legends|father]] [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]]. With the help of an [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]] appointed by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], Chewbacca led attacks on Trade Federation settlements, including an [[Trade Federation outpost|outpost]] and a [[Trade Federation listening array|listening array]]. Noting the success of his strategies, Chewbacca decided to stage an assault on the Trade Federation's main [[Unidentified Trade Federation base|base]] on Alaris Prime after it had been discovered by Wookiee [[Scout/Legends|scouts]].<ref name="GB" />

[[File:Last_Wookiee_base.png|thumb|right|300px|The Wookiees built a new base to attack the Trade Federation.]]
The Wookiees established a [[Unidentified Wookiee base (fortress)|base]] to the south of the Federation settlement, with<ref name="GB" /> Chewbacca's cousin<ref name="TT">''[[Tyrant's Test]]''</ref> [[Shoran]] building a portion of the defensive walls. Jinn remarked that the Wookiees could win the upcoming battle by destroying the Trade Federation's [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] also requested permission from the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] to personally participate in the battle, which was granted on the condition that the Wookiees build a fortress of their own. The base was initially defended by several Wookiees, including a recovered Attichitcuk, Chewbacca, Shoran, seven [[bowcaster trooper]]s, two [[HummBike]] [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder]] scouts, and two [[dragon trooper]]s. The Wookiee workers at the base then began filling in gaps left in the walls and gathering the resources available to them, including [[Muja fruit/Legends|muja fruit]], [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]] from the dense [[Forest/Legends|forests]], [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]], and [[Ore/Legends|ore]].<ref name="GB" />

==The battle==
===Trade Federation offensives===
{{Quote|Incoming droid starfighters. Steel yourself for an attack!|Qui-Gon Jinn, to the Wookiees|audio=IncomingFighters.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:SRAM-13s_droids.png|thumb|left|250px|SRAM-13's droids attack a Wookiee sentry post.]]
The [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|commander]] [[SRAM-13]] commenced the first strike of the battle by sending a force of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]&mdash;five [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|beetle droids]] and a [[Droideka/Legends|droideka]]&mdash;to attack the Wookiee [[Sentry tower/Legends|sentry posts]], which had been built to warn them of the Federation's movements. Jinn recommended that the Wookiees build [[Turret/Legends|turrets]] to fortify their defenses and a [[War Center]] to research upgrades to weapons and [[Armor/Legends|armor]]. After gaining the required resources, the Wookiees upgraded their [[Technology level|level]] of technology to allow them to build their own fortress. SRAM-13 sent a trio of [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|light droid starfighters]] to scout the Wookiee base. Although Jinn warned the Wookiees to brace themselves, the [[Droid starfighter/Legends|fighters]] only performed a reconnaissance mission and did not attack the base.<ref name="GB" />

To prepare for a potential [[Atmosphere/Legends|air]] attack, Jinn recommended the Wookiees create their own aerial defenses before the [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]] returned, including building [[Anti-aircraft gun|anti-air turrets]] as well as an [[Airbase/Legends|airbase]] in which to build their own aircraft. Four [[Droid/Legends|droid]] starfighters then attacked another sentry post, and another fighter flew over the Wookiee base. After the fortress was completed, Jinn headed for the Wookiee base aboard a [[Naboo Royal Lifter]]. Upon his entry, Jinn observed several [[Neimoidian transport|Trade Federation starships]], which he correctly suspected belonged to the Federation's [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] allies, who were plotting to [[Slavery/Legends|enslave]] the Wookiees.<ref name="GB" />

===The storming of the base===
{{Quote|There's the Trade Federation fortress. To win this battle we have to reduce it to scrap!|Qui-Gon Jinn, to the Wookiees|audio=TradeFederationFortress.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Studies of a [[Jedi holocron (Alaris Prime)|Jedi holocron]] previously found by Shoran on Alaris Prime revealed the location of an [[ancient grove]], which the Wookiees uncovered after finding a hidden path through a [[Tree/Legends|treeline]] near their base. Jinn traveled to the grove and uncovered the ancient knowledge of [[Jedi Concentration]], a [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] that allowed him to take control of enemy buildings and use them for the Wookiees' benefit.<ref name="GB" />
{{Endgame}}

[[File:Battle_for_Alaris_Aircraft.png|thumb|right|300px|The Wookiee aircraft cleared the Trade Federation base for the former's infantry.]]
The Wookiees constructed additional military structures in their base, including [[Factory/Legends|factories]] to build [[Mech/Legends|mechs]] and heavy weapons.<ref name="GB" /> Eventually, they prepared a force of ten [[Agr (starfighter)|Agr]] starfighters, three [[Blade bomber|Heavy Blade]] [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]], three [[Energy pummel/Legends|energy pummels]], five [[Sentinel (Wookiees)|Sentinel]] mechs, and five heavy [[Bowcaster/Legends|bowcaster]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] before the Wookiee leaders and Jinn headed for the Trade Federation base. After destroying the turrets outside of the base, they used the bombers to destroy the base's outer walls and turrets while the fighters picked off the droids inside it. Having a clear path, the Wookiee [[Infantry/Legends|ground troops]] marched into the base and used the [[Energy pummel/Legends|pummels]], which had armor that could resist the fortress's turret-fire, to destroy the building and end the battle.<ref name="Prima" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|You've done it. The fortress is destroyed! The Trade Federation has lost its footing on Alaris Prime!|Qui-Gon Jinn, to the Wookiees|audio=WookieeVictory.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:Pekt_ships.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The wreckage of the Trade Federation fortress]]
Jinn celebrated the Wookiee victory, but noticed two [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Transport/Legends|transports]] flying from the ruins of the fortress; the same ships he had seen earlier. Inside one of them, the Trandoshan leader [[Pekt]] swore the Wookiees had not seen the last of him. The Battle for Alaris Prime decisively ended the Trade Federation's colony on Alaris Prime. While still present on Alaris Prime, Jinn reported the victory in a transmission to the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] in which he reflected that he had taught Chewbacca successfully and that the Wookiee was ready to explore the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. Under Wookiee control, Alaris Prime became a thriving technological hub within the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="GB" /> and enjoyed [[Currency/Legends|economic]] success under Chewbacca's leadership.<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|106|Han Solo: The Early Years}}</ref>

However, in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] battle droids would return to the moon in [[Battle of Alaris Prime (Hunt for the Decimator)|multiple]] [[Battle on Alaris|incursions]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], in which the Trade Federation joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in its fight against the Republic.<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Pekt's words came to pass with the [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="GB" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> which allowed him to participate in the mass [[Enslavement of Kashyyyk|enslavement]] of the Wookiees of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. However, he was ultimately stopped by Chewbacca during the [[Liberation of Kashyyyk/Legends|Liberation of Kashyyyk]]<ref name="GB" /> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="NEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Augh&hellip; I am finished.|Qui-Gon Jinn's non-canonical death|audio=PoorQui-Gon.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:Attichitcuk_menu.png|thumb|right|300px|The Battle for Alaris Prime is the culmination of the tutorial campaign in ''Galactic Battlegrounds''.]]
The Battle for Alaris Prime features as the seventh and final level, titled "The Battle for Alaris Prime," of the Wookiee tutorial campaign of the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'',<ref name="GB" /> which was released on [[November 11]], [[2001]].<ref name="GBDate">{{GameSpot|url=games/star-wars-galactic-battlegrounds|text=Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}</ref> The battle was first mentioned in the [[Prima Games]]' [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|strategy guide]] for the game by [[Steven L. Kent]],<ref name="Prima" /> which was released on [[November 7]], 2001.<ref name="PrimaDate">{{Amazon|url=Star-Wars-Galactic-Battlegrounds-Official/dp/0761537503|text=Star Wars Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide}}</ref> Kent wrote that the battle serves as a perfect conclusion to the tutorial campaign, giving the player a full range of technology and units while remaining in a relatively safe level.<ref name="Prima" /> In the level, the player controls the Wookiees and must destroy the Trade Federation fortress to achieve victory. The battle is lost immediately if any of the player's unique hero units&mdash;Chewbacca, Shoran, Attichitcuk, or Qui-Gon Jinn&mdash;are killed. The Trade Federation may create additional forces if given enough time to gather the necessary resources, including a [[bio cannon]] and additional battle droids.<ref name="GB" />

If the player finds the ancient grove, they can use Jinn to gain the ability of Jedi Concentration, which can be researched by certain civilizations in the standard game mode but is otherwise inaccessible in the level as the player cannot build a [[Jedi temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] to research it. Cut dialogue by Jinn suggests that the player would originally have had access to additional Jedi units during the battle but that, in contrast to the standard game mode, the player would then be unable to create any more Jedi&mdash;a restriction that is justified [[in-universe]] by Jinn who states that Jedi law prevents too many Jedi from being assigned on any given mission.<ref name="GB" />
